channel.title: Hommely: Home Finds & Gift Ideas
channel.description: Clever home finds, cozy ideas and gift guides for Canadians.

item.title: The Best Heated Blankets in Canada (2026)
item.description: Cold Canadian evenings? Four heated throws worth buying on Amazon.ca, compared by timer, washability and price in CAD, plus the Canadian safety mark to check before you buy. Cozy winter living room ideas from Hommely.

item.title: 12 Gifts Under $50 in Canada (2026)
item.description: Useful Christmas gifts under $50, priced in Canadian dollars and sorted by budget: under $20, $20 to $35 and $35 to $50. Gift ideas for her, for him, for the cook and for the person who is always cold.

item.title: How to Stop a Draft Under a Door (4 Easy Steps)
item.description: Feel cold air near the door? Find the draft, measure the gap and seal it in about 10 minutes. Includes renter-friendly fixes with no tools or damage. Easy winter home tips for Canadian homes.

item.title: Is a Candle Warmer Lamp Worth It? Honest Pros and Cons
item.description: Worth it or waste? How candle warmer lamps work, what is good, what disappoints, and what they cost to run. Candle scent with no flame and no soot. Cozy home ideas from Hommely.

item.title: Can You Fix This Room in 3 Picks? Play the Hommely Room Challenge
item.description: A 30-second home game: pick 3 finds to fix a cold living room, a chaotic kitchen or a messy closet, stay on budget and get your score. Then challenge a friend to beat it. Cozy home and organizing ideas.

item.title: Made in Canada Gifts Under $25
item.description: Stocking stuffers and small gifts from Canadian brands, sold by Canadian stores. Shop local this Christmas with Made in Canada gift ideas sorted by budget.

item.title: Canadian Winter Essentials for Your Home
item.description: Hand warmers, draft stoppers, humidifiers and more for a warmer Canadian winter at home. Simple buys that make the cold months easier.

item.title: Gifts for Him That Aren't Socks
item.description: Useful gifts for him that he will keep using, sorted by budget. Christmas gift ideas for husbands, dads and brothers in Canada.
